name: Days Custom Design
old_description: "Outstanding customer service. Worked hard to get a rush order for our World Record Camps. They went beyond the "call of duty"! Thank you Days Custom Design!!!"
about:
Days Custom Design is a family-owned custom printing and personalization company based in Casper, Wyoming. Founded in 2020 by Robert, Kathy, and Nevaeh Day, the business was started to help customers turn ideas into high-quality products with personal, dependable service.

The shop provides a range of decoration services including screen printing and direct-to-film transfers for apparel, embroidery for hats and garments, laser engraving on drinkware and wood items, and large-format output such as banners, decals, and storefront window graphics. They also supply promotional products, uniforms, and personalized gifts, serving both local clients in Natrona County and customers nationwide through shipping.

Their customer base spans businesses, schools, sports teams, community organizations, events, and individuals. Past projects include rush shirts for a world-record camp, engraved water bottles for a real estate team, branded drinkware for a medical practice, and custom apparel for a barbecue restaurant. The company works with orders ranging from single personalized gifts to coordinated programs for entire organizations.

Days Custom Design emphasizes a collaborative, honest, and straightforward approach, guiding clients through design and production. The business has been recognized locally, winning Oil City's Best Locally Owned Business in 2025 and Best Customer Service in 2026, reflecting its focus on responsive communication and reliable turnaround.
